fitterkarma was a Filipino alternative indie-art rock project led by Joao de Leon, defined by its "genre-bending" and "dark-emotional" soundscapes. While initially a solo endeavor, the band gained a cult following for its deep Tagalog lyrics and viral tracks like "Pag-Ibig ay Kanibalismo II," which blends folk rock and metal elements.
